knowledge_point.title: Finding the Transpose of a Row Vector or Column Vector

question.:question/problem:
Find ${Z}^{T}$ given that 
$Z=\begin{bmatrix}-20 & 0 & 20 & 1\end{bmatrix}.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns. 

Here, there is just a single row, so it becomes a single column:

$$
{Z}^{T}=\begin{bmatrix}-20 \\ 0 \\ 20 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}
$$
